title: Thirdway carousel
description: A horizontal scroll-snap track with two round outlined arrow buttons (the prev one dims at the start, the next at the end). The controls sit under the track on phones and above it, next to a label, from tablet up.
notes: place it full width: the track pads its own sides with the page gutter and bleeds to the right edge
buttons need JavaScript; the track itself scrolls and snaps without it
name: thirdway-carousel

props.name: children
props.description: the slides; each is wrapped in a snapping list item

props.name: label
props.description: content at the left of the controls row on tablets and up (a count pill and a word)

props.name: prevLabel
props.description: accessible names of the two round buttons

props.name: itemClassName
props.description: classes for each slide's list item (a width, usually); a function gets the slide's index

props.name: trackClassName
props.description: extra classes for the scrolling track, e.g. to turn it into a grid from `lg:` up

props.name: controlsClassName
props.description: extra classes for the controls row, e.g. `lg:hidden`
